After Day 0’s emotional ignition, Day 1 was about structure, clarity, and hands-on bootstrapping. Scaffold the foundational skeleton of a plug-and-play Spring Boot multitenancy starter — just like how Spring Boot itself feels. Thread-safe TenantContextHolder using ThreadLocal
